title: Family laws
summary: Rules every form app obeys: SEDO edits, zero DOM flash, tokens and one z scale, no emoji or em dash, patent declines, one cloud provider (fal), no sparkle icon, commit identity, licence rules. Some are enforced by counts --check.
description: Source of truth is three documents: `CLAUDE.md` (repo notes, patent declines, trademark and licence rules, one cloud provider, sparkle ban, commit identity), the harness `SKILL.md` section "Laws for every change" (12 numbered laws) and `NOTICE.md` (every shipped dependency with its licence; a new one needs a row). Declined and not to return: Content-Aware Scale by seam carving and its skin-tone protection; Poisson blending after the adaptive Content-Aware Fill; a live fill of the vacated area during the Content-Aware Move drag; limiting Selection-Aware Fill sampling by a stored mask; a face mesh in Liquify; image or model providers other than fal; the three-star sparkle icon. Items 10 to 12 are checked by `script.counts-check`; the rest are by review. Commit identity is nodemode-ai with no attribution trailers.

invariants.text: Features declined for patents (seam-carving Content-Aware Scale, its skin-tone protection, Poisson blending after adaptive fill, live fill during Move drag) and declined providers are not added in any form; decline requests for them.
The three-star sparkle icon is banned app-wide under any name, including when porting from formlit.
Every dependency that ships gets a row in NOTICE.md with its licence.
Every commit has one author and committer, nodemode-ai, and no attribution trailer.
No emoji and no U+2014 em dash anywhere (use the interpunct or a colon).

examples.title: Laws block
examples.snippet:
## Laws for every change

1. SEDO: single-region hand edits. Never patch, diff, sed, awk or codemod a tracked file; use the Edit tool for one region per edit and the Write tool for new files.
2. Zero DOM flash, flicker or re-render: render once, then patch in place; reserve space before content arrives. Every UI change passes `references/verification.md`.
3. Colours and z-index come from tokens; icons come from `frontend/src/ui/icons.ts`; no icon libraries.
4. No emoji, no U+2014 em dash (use the interpunct), near-zero comments. Decisions and removed code go in `frontend/HASHOUT_LOG.md` or `backend/HASHOUT_LOG.md` in the same turn.
